info.name: Construction Panel - The Steel
info.description: All Construction Panel APIs for The Steel / Mr-Storage Backend

exec:
const r = pm.response.json();
if (r.data?.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('token', r.data.accessToken);

item.name: Refresh Token
item._postman_note: Returns a new accessToken when the old one expires (refreshToken comes from Login).

item.name: Forgot Password
item._postman_note: Login screen → "Forgot password?". Sends a 6-digit OTP by email. Always answers success (does not reveal whether the email exists).

item.name: Verify OTP
item._postman_note: Returns resetToken for Reset Password.

item.name: Reset Password
item._postman_note: Sets a new password after Verify OTP. Password rules: at least 8 characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, a number and a special character (400 lists every rule that failed).

item.name: Change Password
item._postman_note: Same as Profile → Update Password (prefer that one in the app). Password rules: at least 8 characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, a number and a special character (400 lists every rule that failed).

item.name: Get My Profile
item._postman_note: Profile tab → My Profile. user {name, email, phone, avatar, role, roleLabel (e.g. "Construction Manager" for the read-only Role field), department, notificationSettings}. Password hash and reset-OTP fields are never returned.

response.name: Success

item.name: Upload Profile Photo (Get Presigned URL)
item._postman_note: Step 1 for the camera icon: get uploadUrl, PUT the image file to it, then send fileUrl as avatar in Update My Profile. JPG, PNG or GIF only (checked on save). The 2 MB limit must be checked in the app before uploading — a presigned PUT cannot enforce size on the server.

item.name: Update My Profile
item._postman_note: "Save Changes" on Basic Information. Send only fields that changed. name: required, max 100. email: valid format, not used by another account (case-insensitive) — becomes the new login email. phone: digits, spaces, + - ( ), 7-20 chars, or "" to clear. avatar: http(s) link ending .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.gif, or "" to remove. Role cannot be changed here (ignored). Returns the updated user (same shape as Get My Profile).

response.name: Success
Email taken

item.name: Update Password
item._postman_note: "Update Password" on Security Settings. Rules (same as Password Requirements on screen, also enforced by /auth/change-password and /auth/reset-password): at least 8 characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, a number and a special character. confirmNewPassword is optional but must match when sent; the new password must differ from the current one. The error message lists every rule that failed.

response.name: Success
Weak password

item.name: Update Account Settings (toggles)
item._postman_note: Settings screen → "Save Changes". Keys: twoFactorAuth, emailNotification, smsNotification, dashboardNotifications, loginAlertsViaMail (also weeklyEmailReports, systemAlerts). Values must be JSON true/false (400 otherwise). Send the switches to save; others stay as they are. These are stored preferences.

response.name: Success

item.name: Log out
item._postman_note: "Log out" button. No body needed. The server does not revoke tokens — the app must delete its stored access and refresh tokens. Until they expire (access ~15 min, refresh ~7 days) a copied token would still work.

item.name: Get Dashboard
item._postman_note: Returns: projectStats (total/onTrack/delayed/completed/completionRate/upcomingDeadlines), deliveryOverview, taskOverview, upcomingDeadlines[], recentDeliveries[]

item.name: Get Home

query.description: Optional. Project to show. Omitted → the construction project with the earliest delivery on that day, else the most recently updated active one.
Optional. YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today (server time).

item._postman_note: Construction mobile app Home screen ("Deliveries — Construction Site Performance"). Returns: user {name, role}; currentProject {leadId, projectName, jobId, location, lifecycleStatus} or null; stats {todaysDeliveries, receivedToday, arrived, issuesReported}; incomingDeliveries[] (today's deliveries not yet received: on the way, arrived or pending verification; same card shape as Get All Deliveries) {deliveryId, deliveryNumber, materialName, materialType, loadId, status, statusLabel (same labels as Get All Deliveries), quantity, departureFromPlant, arrivalAtSite, driver {name, phone} | null, carrierName}; alerts[] (Material Alerts & Issues: delivery_delayed | partial_delivery | partially_received | received_with_issues | rejected | bundle_mismatch, newest first). stats.arrived = at site and not yet received; stats.receivedToday = received/partial_received today. "View All" → GET /construction/deliveries?leadId=&startDate=&endDate=.

response.name: Success

item.name: Get Project Calendar
item._postman_note: Returns: calendar object keyed by date (YYYY-MM-DD), each date has array of deliveries

item.name: Get Project BOM Files
item._postman_note: Returns the latest confirmed BOM file per building (same BOMJob data the Plant Panel uses). Use each bomFiles[].fileUrl directly to view/download — it's a direct S3 link, no separate download endpoint needed. bomFiles is [] if no BOM has been uploaded for the project yet.

item.name: Get All Drawings (All Projects)

query.description: drawing | approval | contract | photo | general | other

item._postman_note: Returns: projects[] each with documents[], uploadedBy, lastUpdate, location

item.name: Review Drawing
item._postman_note: Approve or reject a drawing document. approvalStatus: approved | rejected.

item.name: Create Material Request
item._postman_note: "Create" on the Create New Material Request form. Body: leadId (from form-options projects), requiredBy (YYYY-MM-DD, today or later, optional), priority (low | medium | high | critical, default medium), requestedItems[] — one row per "Add Material": { materialType (from form-options materialTypes), quantity > 0, name (required only when materialType is Other) }, remarks (optional), attachments[] (optional, max 20): { name (defaults to the file name in the url), url (http/https), fileSize in bytes }. Upload each file to S3 first: POST {{baseUrl}}/upload/presigned-url { fileName, fileType } → PUT the file to the returned URL → send the file's public url here. requestDate is set by the server; siteLocation defaults to the project location; source = construction; status starts pending. Older { name, quantity } rows are still accepted. Returns 201 materialRequest (same card shape as the list, incl. remarks). 400 on any invalid field (message names the row, e.g. "Material 1: quantity must be greater than 0"); 404 unknown project. On success every active admin is notified (type material_request, refModel MaterialRequest, refId = request _id; high priority for high/critical requests) — visible in GET {{baseUrl}}/notifications.

item.name: Get All Deliveries

query.description: all | incoming | arrived | verification | completed | issues — the chips on the Deliveries screen

item._postman_note: Deliveries screen ("Manage and track all site deliveries"). Returns: deliveries[], total, tab, tabCounts {all, incoming, arrived, verification, completed, issues} (respect leadId/search/date filters, ignore tab), stats{inTransit/staged/ready/totalToday}. Tabs: incoming = not yet at site; arrived = staged/dispatched_to_site/delivered and not scanned; verification = scanned, receipt not confirmed ("Pending Verification"); completed = received/partial_received/rejected; issues = delayed/partial_received/rejected or receipt with issues. Each card also has: materialName, loadId, statusLabel (Scheduled | At Plant | On the Way | Arriving Soon | Arrived | Pending Verification | Delayed | Rescheduled | Completed | Partially Received | Received with Issues | Rejected), quantity, departureFromPlant, arrivalAtSite, driver {name, phone} | null (Delivery.driverName/driverPhone, falls back to the carrier contact), vehicleNumber, carrierName, canScan (false once received → show only "View Details"), verification {scannedAt, outcome, confirmedAt}.

item.name: Get Delivery Detail
item._postman_note: Delivery Details screen ("View Details"). delivery = list card fields + eta, carrierRoute {carrier, finalDestination, truck, driver}, timeline[] {key, label, date, completed} (fulfillment steps + final "received"), weightAndMaterial {weightLbs, units, materialType, packaging}, materialSummary, bundles[] {bundleId, bundleNo, material, expectedUnits, receivedUnits, verification: pending|matched|short|excess}, documents[] {type, name, url}, specialInstructions, receipt (null until confirmed).

item.name: Scan Delivery QR
item._postman_note: Used by: Home card "Track Delivery" (opens the scanner — send the scanned code + that card's deliveryId), Delivery Details "Simulate QR Scan" and More → "Start Verification" (deliveryId only). Scan QR Code / "Simulate QR Scan" → Scan Result screen. Send code (scanned or typed: delivery _id or number like DEL-2001, bundle _id or number like BDL-001) and/or deliveryId (from the delivery card / details screen). deliveryId alone = scan that delivery. With both, the code must belong to that delivery (400 otherwise). A bundle number without deliveryId (QR tab) resolves to its only open delivery; when several projects/trucks match, the one already at site (arrived or scanned) is used; still ambiguous → 409 with data.candidates[] {deliveryId, deliveryNumber, projectName} so the app can let the user pick and re-send with deliveryId. The first scan stamps receipt.scannedAt, moving the delivery to the "Verification" tab. Returns: delivery (same shape as Get Delivery Detail), scannedBundleId, alreadyReceived (true → show read-only, no verification).

response.name: Success

item.name: Scan QR (QR tab — code only)
item._postman_note: Bottom-nav QR tab: "Scan the delivery or material QR code" / "Enter Bundle ID" → Simulate QR Scan. Same endpoint and response as Scan Delivery QR, just without deliveryId. Then Verify Materials → Confirm Material Receipt → Download Material Receipt PDF, exactly as from a delivery card.

response.name: Ambiguous bundle number

item.name: Confirm Material Receipt
item._postman_note: Verify Materials → Update Delivery Status → "Confirm Material Receipt". outcome: fully_received | partially_received | received_with_issues | rejected. items[]: receivedQty (whole number ≥ 0) for every bundle on the delivery (bundleId from the scan/detail bundles[]); may be omitted only for rejected. fully_received is refused (400) if any bundle is short. Delivery status becomes received / partial_received / received / rejected; per-bundle quantityStatus = matched | short | excess. Plant and Admin users are notified automatically (high priority unless fully received). One confirmation per delivery (400 on repeat). Returns the "Delivery Updated!" screen data: status, statusLabel, receipt {outcome, outcomeLabel, totalExpected, totalReceived, shortQty, excessQty, items[]}, receiptUrl.

item.name: Search Chat (WhatsApp-style)

query.description: Search text (message text or file name). Required when type=all; optional with a chip. Max 100 chars.
all | photos | documents | links | videos | gifs | audio | polls | events — the chips under the search box
Optional: search inside one direct chat
Optional: search inside one group (403 if not a member)

item._postman_note: Construction app Home → 🔍 Search screen (works like WhatsApp search). Searches only chats you can open: your direct chats and groups you are a member of. type=all → messages whose text or file name matches q (kind "message", with attachments[]). Media chips (photos/documents/videos/gifs/audio) → one item per file (kind photo|document|video|gif|audio, file {url, name, mimeType}); q optional, matches file name or message text. Files are classified by MIME type, else by extension; anything not photo/gif/video/audio is a document. links → messages containing http(s) links (kind "link", links[]). polls / events → 200 with empty items and supported:false (team chat has no polls or events yet). Every item has messageId, sender {userId, name, isMe}, conversation {type direct|group, userId|groupId, name, avatar}, sentAt. Newest first; total/page/limit/totalPages for paging.

response.name: Text search (type=all)
Photos chip (type=photos)
Polls chip (not supported yet)
